# internet-ui

> Source-owned React components built with Base UI, Tailwind CSS v4, and Motion.

Use the CLI to copy component source into a project. Do not install `@internet-ui/ui` as a runtime dependency.

```bash
npx @ternetin/ui init
npx @ternetin/ui add button input dialog
```

## Resources

- [Full source catalog](https://ui.ter.net.in/llms-full.txt): component metadata and complete source files
- [JSON registry](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/registry.json): machine-readable component index
- [Storybook](https://storybook.ui.ter.net.in): rendered component examples

## Components

- [Theme](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/theme.json): internet-ui design tokens (Tailwind v4). Import once from your global stylesheet.
- [cn utility](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/utils.json): Shared clsx/tailwind-merge utility and fixed nested-popup geometry.
- [Motion presets](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/motion.json): Shared animation language: easing curves, duration and spring tokens, and the render-prop helpers that animate Base UI popups with Motion.
- [Syntax highlighter](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/highlight.json): Dependency-free tokenizer behind the Code component's language prop. Shell, JS/TS/JSX, JSON, CSS and HTML.
- [Accordion](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/accordion.json): Accordion built on Base UI.
- [Alert Dialog](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/alert-dialog.json): Alert Dialog built on Base UI.
- [Autocomplete](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/autocomplete.json): Autocomplete built on Base UI.
- [Avatar](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/avatar.json): Avatar built on Base UI.
- [Button](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/button.json): Button built on Base UI.
- [Card](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/card.json): Composable flat card with semantic variants, shared geometry, and optional public-page corner brackets.
- [Checkbox Group](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/checkbox-group.json): Checkbox Group built on Base UI.
- [Checkbox](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/checkbox.json): Checkbox built on Base UI.
- [Code](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/code.json): Single-line or multi-line code snippet with an optional title strip, syntax highlighting and a copy button. Plain styled container — not a Base UI primitive.
- [Collapsible](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/collapsible.json): Collapsible built on Base UI.
- [Combobox](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/combobox.json): Combobox built on Base UI.
- [Context Menu](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/context-menu.json): Context Menu built on Base UI.
- [Dialog](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/dialog.json): Dialog built on Base UI.
- [Data Table](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/data-table.json): Generic TanStack table with sorting, global filtering, pagination, page-size controls, and row selection.
- [Drawer](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/drawer.json): Drawer built on Base UI.
- [Field](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/field.json): Field built on Base UI.
- [Fieldset](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/fieldset.json): Fieldset built on Base UI.
- [Form](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/form.json): Form built on Base UI.
- [Input](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/input.json): Input built on Base UI.
- [Menu](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/menu.json): Menu built on Base UI.
- [Menubar](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/menubar.json): Menubar built on Base UI.
- [Meter](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/meter.json): Meter built on Base UI.
- [Navigation Menu](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/navigation-menu.json): Navigation Menu built on Base UI.
- [Number Field](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/number-field.json): Number Field built on Base UI.
- [OTP Field](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/otp-field.json): OTP Field built on Base UI.
- [Popover](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/popover.json): Popover built on Base UI.
- [Preview Card](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/preview-card.json): Preview Card built on Base UI.
- [Progress](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/progress.json): Progress built on Base UI.
- [Radio Group](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/radio-group.json): Radio Group built on Base UI.
- [Scroll Area](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/scroll-area.json): Scroll Area built on Base UI.
- [Select](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/select.json): Select built on Base UI.
- [Separator](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/separator.json): Separator built on Base UI.
- [Slider](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/slider.json): Slider built on Base UI.
- [Switch](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/switch.json): Switch built on Base UI.
- [Tabs](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/tabs.json): Tabs built on Base UI.
- [Toast](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/toast.json): Toast built on Base UI.
- [Toggle Group](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/toggle-group.json): Toggle Group built on Base UI.
- [Toggle](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/toggle.json): Toggle built on Base UI.
- [Toolbar](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/toolbar.json): Toolbar built on Base UI.
- [Tooltip](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/tooltip.json): Tooltip built on Base UI.
- [ASCII SVG](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/ascii-svg.json): Globs an SVG from its children and renders it as live, animatable ASCII art by rasterizing to a canvas and mapping brightness onto a character ramp.
- [Page Layout](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/page-layout.json): Shared page container, title, description, actions, and sections.
- [Auth Layout](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/auth-layout.json): Centered responsive authentication composition, without auth logic.
- [App Shell](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/app-shell.json): Application header, body, and independent main scroll region.
- [Sidebar](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/sidebar.json): Composable app-owned navigation links, buttons, and sidebar regions.
- [Sidebar Drawer](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/sidebar-drawer.json): Accessible controlled mobile navigation with focus restoration.
- [Split Pane](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/split-pane.json): Controlled responsive list/detail panes with mobile focus management.
- [Settings Section](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/settings-section.json): Consistent settings heading, description, body, and actions.
- [Stat](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/stat.json): Compact, accessible dashboard label/value composition.
- [Badge](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/badge.json): Text-first semantic status label.
- [Alert](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/alert.json): Inline informational, success, warning, or error feedback.
- [Empty State](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/empty-state.json): Empty or recovery state with an explanation and optional next action.
- [Spinner](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/spinner.json): Accessible progress feedback for a small pending action.
- [Skeleton](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/skeleton.json): Reduced-motion-aware content loading placeholder.
- [Input Group](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/input-group.json): Joined inputs and addons with automatic outer corners.
- [Textarea](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/textarea.json): Native multiline input with shared field states.
- [Authentication Example](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/auth-example.json): Complete centered authentication form with illustrative local submission.
- [Admin Example](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/admin-example.json): Complete metrics and filterable table page with fictional data.
- [Settings Example](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/settings-example.json): Complete settings form, joined input, switch, and local feedback.
- [Workspace Example](https://ui.ter.net.in/r/workspace-example.json): Complete responsive sidebar/list/detail workspace with fictional messages.
